adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the booking reference mapping was changed from `credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` to `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`. This is a functional change: for non-calendar results (e.g., video/conferencing integrations), `result.credentialId` is no longer persisted into the reference at all. Since the previous code explicitly stored `result.credentialId` for non-calendar results, this diff demonstrably drops that data and can break any later logic that expects a reference to carry the conferencing credential id.
